# E0106: a version file declares a field twice

A version file declares each of its fields once. CUE would unify two
declarations of schema; a version file has one schema, written in one place.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a: string
}

Schema: {
	b: int
}
```

`ship/tip.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a: string
}

Schema: {
	b: int
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0106]: history/0.0.thema declares Schema twice
 --> ship/history/0.0.thema:5:1
  |
1 | Schema: {
  | ------ first declared here
...
5 | Schema: {
  | ^^^^^^
  |
```
